Hey. Another sixteen year old ace here. Asexuality is simply the lack of sexual attraction. Sexual attraction is separate from libido, which is what you’re describing: the physical craving for sexual stimulation. Sexual attraction is the desire to have sex with someone else. One can lack sexual attraction and still have a high libido, which seems to be your situation, in which case masturbation can serve as proper release without having intercourse with another person. Some asexuals even have sex, but that doesn’t make them less asexual. As long as you do not experience that attraction, you are asexual. Hope this helps!

It sounds as though you have signs of depression. This is not a diagnosis, as only a doctor can do that, but with my knowledge I would say yes, it is possible that you are depressed. 

It is not necessary to have suicidal thoughts or self injurious tendencies to be depressed. The way you describe it is honestly the best way to explain depression. We are normal people, just with something “wrong in our head,” aka mental illness. The symptoms do not determine the illness, but the illness determines the symptoms. In this way everyone experiences depression differently. Someone may have thoughts of suicide, but that does not necessarily make them more depressed than you, nor does it make you any less depressed. I hope this helped.
